profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your investigator identity and account security.
profile.displayNameHint: Leave empty to use your username.
profile.usernameText: Used to sign in. It cannot be changed.
profile.storageText: Your cases and media are encrypted and never leave this computer. Cloud sync is coming in a later version.

password.title: Password
password.text: Use a long, unique password that you do not use anywhere else.
password.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from the current one

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.text: Require a code from your phone in addition to your password when signing in.
twofa.enabledText: Sign-in asks for a 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twofa.disabledText: Add a second layer of protection with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy.
twofa.disableText: Confirm with your password and a current code from your authenticator app.
twofa.codeHint: The 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.

totp.restarted: The setup was reset. Scan the new code and try again.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.step1Text: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy on your phone.
totp.step3Text: Type the code the app shows for E-Board to confirm.
totp.successText: From now on, signing in will also ask for a code from your authenticator app.

delete.title: Danger zone
delete.label: Delete account
delete.rowText: Permanently removes your account with all cases, boards and media.
delete.warningText: All cases, evidence boards, cards and images stored for this account on this device will be erased.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Language and colours of the app.

language.label: Language
language.description: Arabic switches the interface to right-to-left.

appTheme.label: App theme
appTheme.description: Pages, menus and dialogs. Boards keep their own theme.

boardTheme.label: Default board theme
boardTheme.description: Used for new boards. Any board can switch theme at any time.

detective.name: Detective
detective.text: Cork board, push pins, red string

toolbar.label: Toolbar position
toolbar.description: Where the tool dock sits on the board. You can also drag it to any edge.

wheel.label: Mouse wheel
wheel.description: Ctrl + wheel and touchpad pinch always zoom.

grid.label: Show grid
grid.description: Background grid on boards that use one.

animations.label: Animations
animations.description: Flowing threads and subtle motion effects.

security.title: Security
security.description: Protect your cases when you step away.

autoLock.label: Auto-lock
autoLock.description: E-Board locks itself after this long without activity. Lock instantly at any time with

about.title: About
about.description: Version and where your data lives.
about.dataLocationText: Your encrypted database and media files are kept in this folder.
